subject: ISO 27001 + FedRAMP: scope clarifications and sample window planning
messages:
From: Claire Rivera <claire@ridgecompliance.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmepayments.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: ISO/FedRAMP readiness - clarifying scope and sample window

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the intake packet you submitted. Reviewing the control matrix there are a few scope clarifications we need before we lock the audit window:

- System boundary: does the "Inference Control Plane" include the private deployment appliance (on-prem) for customers, or is that a distinct boundary for the purposes of ISO 27001?
- Logging: we saw references to streaming token logs and ephemeral caches. For FedRAMP log sampling we need the retention policy and where audit logs are stored (centralized S3 vs local host). Can you confirm retention durations and the location?
- Evidence sampling: auditors typically pick a 90-day sample window. Do you have a preferred blackout/sprint window in October-November where we should avoid heavy change freezes?

If you can answer these at a high level we can propose an initial audit schedule and a short list of required artifacts (control narratives, runbooks, sample logs). If it's easier, happy to set a 30m call next week.

Regards,
Claire Rivera
Senior Engagement Lead
Ridge Compliance Partners

Subject: Re: ISO/FedRAMP readiness - clarifying scope and sample window

Claire, Grace — answering the bullets below and attaching supporting artifacts. See attachments: control-matrix.xlsx, sys-architecture.pdf, log-retention-policy.docx.

1) System boundary
- Short answer: The "Inference Control Plane" for certification purposes will include Hosted API and Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) where we operate the inference runtime. Private deployments that are customer-managed (on-prem or VPC with customer-managed control plane) are scoped out as customer-managed boundary and treated as a different boundary for ISO/FedRAMP evidence.
- Suggested narrative sentence for the control matrix: "Redwood Inference's ISO/FedRAMP certification covers the company-managed inference control plane comprising the Hosted API and Redwood Dedicated environments. Customer-managed private deployments fall outside this certification boundary unless Redwood explicitly operates the appliance under a managed contract."

2) Logging and retention
- Audit logs: centralized in our secure S3 bucket (us-west-2) with MFA delete and KMS envelope encryption. Retention default: 1 year for audit logs, 90 days for structured token trace logs, 30 days for ephemeral KV cache snapshots.
- PII redaction: token traces are redacted at ingest via the runtime scrubber; PII fields are hashed and access requires elevated role. See log-retention-policy.docx for mapping and access controls.

3) Sample window / blackout
- Product has two short release sprints: Oct 10-14 and Nov 8-12. We recommend avoiding the 90-day sample window that would include Oct 10-14. If auditors prefer Nov->Jan window we are OK, but the preferred audit window is Nov 15 - Feb 15 to minimize overlap with our planned feature rollouts.

Next steps:
- Grace: please confirm the narrative sentence above and attach the control-matrix.xlsx mapping to the auditor intake.
- Claire: once you confirm the window we'll publish proposed artifact requests and schedule the pre-audit walkthrough.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- control-matrix.xlsx (control-to-evidence mapping)
- sys-architecture.pdf (high-level diagram with component boundaries)
- log-retention-policy.docx (retention durations and access controls)

- Control mapping: the narrative sentence is fine; please add it to column B in the control-matrix and upload to the Ridge portal.
- Logs: the retention matrix is acceptable. For FedRAMP moderate we'll want exportable log samples covering failed auth, admin actions, and model-access events — please make sure redaction does not strip event types.
- Blackout window: we will propose a 90-day sample window starting 2027-11-20 through 2028-02-17. That avoids your Oct sprints and gives our audit team time to collect artifacts.

Action items for Redwood: upload the updated control-matrix.xlsx, confirm where the sample logs will be pulled from (S3 path + read-only role), and provide a point-of-contact for on-call during artifact collection.

Can we aim to have items uploaded by Oct 7 so we can lock dates and send out the pre-audit invite? I'll coordinate with Lisa on the procurement side for final contracting timelines.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll add the proposed window to the portal and send a calendar hold tentatively.
